Lessons.Title: Numbers Within 100,000
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will read, write, and represent multi-digit numbers up to the ten-thousands.
In this lesson, you count to read and write multi-digit numbers up to the ten-thousands place. You also count to develop a sense of the magnitude of 10,000. In the previous lesson, you counted by thousands and created 10 groups of 1,000 to make 10,000.
Core relationship: Place-value counting through 100,000. Count forward by units of 1, 10, 100 or 1,000, including exchanges across place-value boundaries.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Choral Count: By 1,000	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Count and Write Numbers	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  Many Thousands	 (15 minutes); Cool-down:  Count Ten-thousands	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: What follows 9,950 when counting by tens?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Starting at 9,995, what are the next five numbers when counting by ones?
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.

KeyConcepts.Title: Place-value counting through 100,000
KeyConcepts.Rule: Count forward by units of 1, 10, 100 or 1,000, including exchanges across place-value boundaries.

KeyConcepts.Title: Base-ten representation
KeyConcepts.Definition: A five-digit number is the sum of its place values.
KeyConcepts.Rule: A five-digit number is the sum of its place values.

KeyConcepts.Title: Inverse verification
KeyConcepts.Definition: Zeros hold the position of absent place values.
KeyConcepts.Rule: Zeros hold the position of absent place values.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Skipping a new ten-thousands digit at a place-value boundary.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: It changes the unit, place value, or operation.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Count forward by units of 1, 10, 100 or 1,000, including exchanges across place-value boundaries.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Reading the digit 3 in 43,205 as only 3.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: The stated place value, scale, or arithmetic relationship is not preserved.
